thread.title: US STOCKS-Wall St futures flat, eyes on China impact

author: nasdaq.com
title: US STOCKS-Wall St futures flat, eyes on China impact
text:
Shutterstock photo
(For a live blog on the U.S. stock market, click LIVE/ ortype LIVE/ in a news window)
* Futures: Dow off 0.01 pct, S&P flat, Nasdaq off 0.04 pct
By Sruthi Shankar
Initial releases in a bumper day of results on Tuesdayshowed Xerox CorpXRX.N rising 5.8 percent in premarkettrading after beating profit estimates, while Pfizer IncPFE.N fell 1.7 percent and Harley-Davidson IncHOG.N plunged about 8percent. urn:newsml:reuters.com:*:nL3N1ZT44A
Wall Street sold off on Monday after Caterpillar IncCAT.N and Nvidia CorpNVDA.O joined a growing list of companies toblame a slowdown in China for the grim forecasts. urn:newsml:reuters.com:*:nL3N1ZS4NN
Whirlpool CorpWHR.N , another major China-linked business,dropped 5.6 percent after the home appliances maker warned of ahigher tax bill, costs and a strong dollar hitting its 2019profit and revenue. urn:newsml:reuters.com:*:nL3N1ZS569
In a potential setback to the progress in U.S-China tradetalks, the U.S. Justice Department leveled charges againstChina's telecom giant HuaweiHWT.UL days before a high-levelmeeting between the two countries in Washington, aimed to tacklea prolonged tariff war that has roiled financial markets. urn:newsml:reuters.com:*:nL1N1ZS19N
Reports this week from high-profile companies includingApple Inc AAPL.O , which has already issued a sales alert dueto weak demand from China, and Boeing CoBA.N could worsen the fears.
Although earnings have largely surpassed Wall Street'sexpectations, helping the S&P 500 climb about 12 percent fromits December lows, worries about slowing global growth havetempered expectations.
Since the reporting season began two weeks ago, analysts'estimates for fourth-quarter profit growth have stayed steady atabout 14 percent, but expectations for 2019 earnings growth havedropped to 5.6 percent from 6.3 percent, according to IBES datafrom Refinitiv.
At 6:59 a.m. ET, Dow e-minis 1YMc1 were down 2 points, or0.01 percent. S&P 500 e-minis ESc1 remained unchanged andNasdaq 100 e-minis NQc1 were down 3 points, or 0.04 percent.
The Federal Reserve begins a two-day meeting on interestrate on Tuesday. After raising rates gradually last year, thecentral bank is taking a wait-and-see approach to furthertightening in the face of an overseas slowdown and marketvolatility. urn:newsml:reuters.com:*:nL1N1ZO1I6
Pfizer fell after the drugmaker forecast full-year revenuebelow analysts' estimate. urn:newsml:reuters.com:*:nL3N1ZT3XN
Harley-Davidson dropped after the motorcycle maker reporteda lower-than-expected quarterly profit, hit by declining salesin the United States. urn:newsml:reuters.com:*:nL3N1ZT47K
PG&E CorpPCG.N plunged 6.2 percent after the powerprovider filed for voluntary Chapter 11 bankruptcy protectionlate on Tuesday, succumbing to liabilities stemming fromwildfires in Northern California in 2017 and 2018. urn:newsml:reuters.com:*:nL3N1ZT38Z (Reporting by Sruthi Shankar and Shreyashi Sanyal in Bengaluru;Editing by Shounak Dasgupta) (( sruthi.shankar@thomsonreuters.com ; within U.S. +1 646 2238780; outside U.S. +91 80 6749 6328; Reuters Messaging: sruthi.shankar.reuters.com@reuters.net ))
